pressure_observation: The static pressure is highest near the inlet section and decreases smoothly through the converging portion, reaching its lowest values in the diverging nozzle section.
mach_observation: The Mach number increases smoothly from subsonic values at the inlet through the throat and reaches supersonic conditions in the diverging section.
velocity_observation: The velocity magnitude field mirrors the Mach number behavior, showing low speeds upstream and accelerating significantly through the nozzle throat and downstream.
mesh_observation: The mesh is structured and uniformly distributed across the domain with moderate resolution, showing no signs of severe skewness or distortion.
